build: cargo build --release --bin umber --example layout; default features, fat LTO, codegen-units=1
endpoint_note: Umber CLI parses plain+Gentle and retains detached output without DVI/JSON serialization; native writes DVI/log. Warm caches; no recorder; complete child process including startup/teardown.

measurement_driver.status: ignored local driver; uses existing benchmarks/layout.py child/rss and benchmarks/gentle.py comparison helpers

profiles.tool: Valgrind/Callgrind 3.22.0, Ir only, actual default-feature release binaries, no recorder
profiles.scope: Separate whole-process instruction diagnostics. Self function counts aggregate inlined source-file entries by physical function name; parser self sum equals program total. These are not CPU time shares and are never subtracted from child CPU timings.
profiles.output_check: All profiled processes exit 0; Umber stdout equals ordinary stdout; native final DVI events/counts equal the retained reference.

sampling_limit.cpu_time_sampling: Not available. Existing gprofng attempt on this host did not provide usable samples; see benchmarks/results/layout-node-singleton.json sampling_probe. No CPU hotspot fractions inferred from Ir.

historical_native_comparison: The retained earlier broad-search native practical samples in probe.json have median 202.987 ms CPU. This run uses the explicit immutable TeX Live search environment recorded above (58.358 ms). Different startup/search setup, not an engine optimization or longitudinal speedup.

ranked_diagnostics.observations: 805,784 calls to NodeStore::get and 585,954 to writable in the physical call graph. Main get callers: paragraph 326,057; lowering 199,600; hpack 175,376. Source annotation executes no node-chunk COW copy body; allocation_page draws a backing page 581 times for 190,331 node allocations. Counts describe repeated resolving/ownership work, not demonstrated allocation growth.
ranked_diagnostics.assessment: A future scoped chunk traversal/build interface is the clearest structural candidate, but no prototype benefit is established. Preserve version ownership and quiescent checkpoints; wait for full-document replay allocation results before choosing work.

ranked_diagnostics.observations: character_run: 35,927,573 self Ir (12.30%); publish_page: 18,127,048 self Ir (6.21%). These include necessary text/ligature processing and detached output. Their node-helper descendants overlap the first area; inclusive shares cannot be added. Font lookup is already bound per run/traversal and glyph/node storage is pooled.
ranked_diagnostics.assessment: No isolated algorithmic pathology or justification for a generic shaping layer, skipped output, or per-case micro-tuning.

ranked_diagnostics.area: Token input, expansion and alignment control
ranked_diagnostics.observations: fetch_raw: 21,887,365 self Ir (7.50%); alignment_token: 9,136,796 self Ir (3.13%) across 325,977 hook calls. The alignment hook immediately exits when inactive, while active input preserves brace/template semantics. Pattern child/insert_child use 5,095,186/4,793,603 self Ir; plain source loading is included.
ranked_diagnostics.assessment: Distributed interpreter costs. Prepared plain/checkpoint replay is a distinct endpoint and should be measured before optimizing format loading or token plumbing.

conclusion: Healthy ordinary full-document baseline (about 49–50 ms CPU and 6.21 MiB RSS) with distributed instruction work. No engine optimization implemented or approved from this profile. Compare prepared checkpoint replay and allocation/high-water behavior separately; do not conflate those with fresh-process native ratios.
